visual_action: A large, diverse crowd of people is gathered for a protest in front of the U.S. Supreme Court building on a sunny day. People are holding signs advocating for birthright citizenship. The camera pans slowly across the scene, showing the crowd, the signs, and the building in the background. An American flag is visible on a flagpole.

cast.name: ACLU
cast.evidence: A protest sign reads "Protect BIRTH RIGHT Citizenship" with the ACLU logo at the bottom.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: A protest sign in the background reads "TRUMP MUST GO". The post's text "no president can change this fact" also implicitly references his stated positions on birthright citizenship.

on_screen_text.text:
no president can change this fact:

if you were born here, you are american.
PEACE IN KOREA PEACE IN OUR LIFE

spoken_summary: The audio consists of lyrics from the song 'America the Beautiful,' specifically the line 'From sea to shining sea' being sung powerfully.
audio_music: The audio is a powerful, patriotic, and uplifting rendition of "America The Beautiful" by Whitney Houston that plays throughout the clip.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a single, slow-panning shot across the protest scene.
central_claim: Birthright citizenship is a fundamental, unchangeable American right that no president can eliminate.
intended_effect: To inspire pride in American values, rally support for birthright citizenship, and galvanize opposition to political figures who threaten it.
